scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); const files=fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>/\.(svg|png|jpg|jpeg|ico|json|css|js|woff2|ttf)$/.test(f)); files.forEach(f=>{ try{ fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/'+f); }catch(e){} }); console.log('Build complete - public assets synced:', files.length);"
